ranked_findings.finding: Shared local filesystem operation gate is the clearest concurrency wait. Per-kind read/commit/prepare elapsed sums rise substantially; overlapping waits are not elapsed critical path or CPU.

Metadata refresh and publication account for substantial inclusive awaited work. Freshness read transactions and SQL rounds are a candidate seam, but these windows include lane setup/open/close and current evidence does not prove TiDB lock contention.

One-lane distinct uploads account for about199ms inclusive; eight-lane repeated contents produce5confirmed creates,18conditional conflicts+verification,17followers. Matching content before a causal concurrency comparison is required.

Backing verifier uses37/72 probe GETs plus37/72 data GETs and body reads, totaling41.238/70.747ms in verify_backing. Retry backoff and marker create are0in both workloadwindows; adapter calls are not HTTPattempts.
TiDB pool checkout inclusive totals remain tiny; matched server retry/deadlock value counters remain0. This does not bound queue-only waits or establish absence of contention at larger load.
